name: RWS Holdings (RWS)
teaser: At 151.77p the shares trade 19.1% above my Base value of 122.76p. My Base already includes a recovery and an acquisition, so this is not a no-turnaround case. The price needs about 78% of EBITDA to turn into operating cash, against the 65% the company itself aims for, and it needs it for good. The required margin of safety of 45% puts the maximum buy price at 67.52p. Reduce for holders, watchlist for new money. Full-year results to September 30, 2026 are not in this analysis.
llms: RWS Holdings (RWS), the London-listed language, content and IP services group moving into AI data and software, is valued on owner cash after capital spending, interest, leases and stock pay with a two year transition, cross-checked with a sum of the parts. Bear 68.58p, Base 122.76p, Bull 199.49p. Verdict Reduce at 151.77p, maximum buy price 67.52p.
